meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 处理 Git 时会先判断请求属于提交、改写历史、查历史还是看状态,不擅自提交、推送或改写历史;提交时按逻辑拆分,沿用仓库习惯的提交说明,最后汇报提交编号、说明与剩余未提交文件。
howto.when: 当任务需要做一次 Git 提交,或调查 Git 历史(如某行是谁改的、哪些提交动了某个文件)时触发;普通代码编辑不会触发。

say.text: 把我改动的文件分别提交,每个功能一个提交。
say.note: 会按逻辑拆分,并沿用仓库近期的提交消息风格。

say.text: 这个文件第 10 行是谁改的?
say.note: 会用 git blame 找出作者及提交编号。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个。
say.note: 会用交互式变基重写历史,并展示新的提交记录。

howto.what_en: Claude classifies Git requests (commit/rewrite history/inspect history/status), never mutates without an explicit ask, splits changes into logical commits, follows the repo's commit style, and reports hashes, messages, and remaining uncommitted files.
howto.when_en: Used when the task needs a Git commit or a Git-history investigation; ordinary code edits do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Commit my changed files separately, one feature per commit.
say_en.note: Splits logically and follows the repo's commit style

say_en.text: Who changed line 10 of this file?
say_en.note: Uses git blame to show author and commit hash

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Rewrites with interactive rebase, then shows the new log
